sequence.method: All complete source frames forward and backward, adjacent frames at the seam, cosine-eased turnaround timing, no opacity blend
sequence.spatial: One common crop and scale, foot pivot from lowest boot band excluding staff tip, no per-frame rescaling or body-part deformation

runtime.idle: Countdown, or no live enemy in attack range with no pending attack and casting pose timer finished
runtime.combat: Freeze the same new complete-character frame and idle phase; resume from that phase when idle
runtime.facing: Direct complete-character left/right mirror follows target and actual attack direction
runtime.clock: Battle simulation delta; paused game freezes animation
runtime.legacy: Old thunder-mage artwork and UV deformation no longer instantiated for volt
runtime.attack: New matching attack frames remain to be produced; existing projectiles, skill, ultimate, damage and sound retained

review: Source frame annotation and asset production only; effects reviewed manually by user. No tests, browser, game or online QA executed. Static-picture acceptance is not recorded as animation acceptance.
